name: uberasm-filter-items-when-exiting-pipe
title: Filter Items When Exiting Pipe
description:
This resource allows you to disable bringing any item you carry through a pipe while keeping the pipe animation.

There are two variants included in here:
  • filter_item_pipe_total.asm
    will erase any carried item you bring in the level you insert this at.
  • filer_item_pipe_conditional.asm
    will erase carried items depending on the value of a secondary exit. Useful when you have many pipes in one level and want to filter items from some of them only.
